title: DaDokk_'s Economy Mod
description: A simple mod, that adds a currency for multiplayer and a wallet to store your earnings.
body:
# **DaDokk_'s Economy Mod**

This is a mod, that adds a simple economy system to Minecraft. It adds 3 types of coins: 
### Copper coin
Priced at $1
### Silver coin
Priced at $16
### Gold coin
Priced at $256

![Copper, Silver and Gold Coins](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5684314b09c46b12dd0939130a063d7d5c25278.png)

The mod also adds a **_Wallet_**. The wallet allows player to store and exchange money. It can store an infinite amount of money.

![The Wallet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/76ca0d7ea1adabc02a03a9f290da35b9bad3e278_0.webp)

The mod is designed mainly for small multiplayer servers. The coins aren't craftable, so **the server admin has to give the coins to players manualy.**
